title: When the Typewriter Wakes
author: Astrid Voss
blurb: Paloma Eastwick, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
